check_box.label: Glow
check_box.name: ks_glow
check_box.tool_tip: The viewer's glow pass: faces with a Glow value, anything brighter than Bloom threshold (the sun and the sky around it included) and AyaneStorm's bright-surface bloom (Camera Effects) all blur through it. No effect while Build > Options > No Post-processing is on and the Build floater is open.

slider.label: Glow strength
slider.name: ks_glow_strength
slider.tool_tip: How bright all glow and bloom are.

slider.label: Glow width
slider.name: ks_glow_width
slider.tool_tip: Spacing between blur samples (width / resolution). Too wide leaves gaps and the glow turns blocky: lower it, or raise Glow resolution or Glow iterations.

slider.label: Glow resolution
slider.name: ks_glow_res
slider.tool_tip: Height of the glow buffer: 8 = 256, 9 = 512, 10 = 1024 rows (it is always 1024 wide). Higher keeps a wide glow smooth. (KS Reference)

slider.label: Glow iterations
slider.name: ks_glow_iter
slider.tool_tip: Blur rounds: higher is wider and smoother, and each round costs two passes. Preferences calls this Strength (0-3). (KS Reference)

slider.label: Bloom threshold
slider.name: ks_glow_threshold
slider.tool_tip: Brightness above which anything blooms (the sun, bright sky, lit surfaces), fading in over the next 1.0. Measured on the red channel by default. Lower blooms more of the scene.

slider.label: Bloom amount
slider.name: ks_glow_amount
slider.tool_tip: How strongly anything above Bloom threshold blooms, at most (faces with a Glow value use their own). 0 turns this bloom off.
